title: Unit 8 L2: I wish / If only
source: Henry's Unit 8 lesson packs (M.3 Communication), Nov 13. American spelling (apologize, not the British -ise).

questions.q: I'm shy and I don't like it. "I wish I ___ so shy."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I wasn't so shy.

questions.q: Last night I shouted at my friend. Now I feel bad. "If only I ___ at her."
questions.read_aloud: If only I hadn't shouted at her.

questions.q: I can't swim, and my friends are going to the pool. "I wish I ___ swim."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I could swim.

questions.q: Which sentence is about the PAST?
choices: I wish I had more money.
I wish I had studied for the test.
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had studied for the test.

questions.q: Which sentence is about NOW?
choices: I wish I had a bigger room.
I wish I hadn't told him.
If only I hadn't lost my phone.
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had a bigger room.

questions.q: "I wish I was taller." After I wish, which other word is also correct here?
questions.read_aloud: I wish I were taller.

questions.q: I didn't study for the exam and I failed. "If only I ___!"
questions.read_aloud: If only I had studied!

questions.q: A friend says: "I wish I hadn't eaten so much." How does your friend feel?
questions.read_aloud: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.

questions.q: A friend says: "If only I could play the guitar." Can your friend play the guitar?
questions.read_aloud: If only I could play the guitar.

questions.q: My friend is angry because I forgot her birthday. "I wish I ___ her birthday."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I hadn't forgotten her birthday.

questions.q: I'm short. "I wish I ___ taller."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I were taller.

questions.q: I have a lot of homework. "I wish I ___ so much homework."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I didn't have so much homework.

questions.q: I ate too much cake. "If only I ___ so much cake."
questions.read_aloud: If only I hadn't eaten so much cake.

questions.q: I can't swim. "I wish I ___ swim."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I could swim.

questions.q: It's raining. "I wish it ___ raining."
questions.read_aloud: I wish it would stop raining.

questions.q: I failed the test. "If only I ___ harder."
questions.read_aloud: If only I had studied harder.

questions.q: I don't live near the beach. "I wish I ___ near the beach."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I lived near the beach.

questions.q: He is not here. "I wish he ___ here."
questions.read_aloud: I wish he were here.

questions.q: We missed the bus. "If only we ___ earlier."
questions.read_aloud: If only we had left earlier.

questions.q: I lost my phone. "I wish I ___ it."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I hadn't lost it.

questions.q: I don't have a pet. "I wish I ___ a dog."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had a dog.

questions.q: She said something mean. "I wish she ___ that."
questions.read_aloud: I wish she hadn't said that.

questions.q: My neighbor is noisy. "I wish he ___ quiet."
questions.read_aloud: I wish he would be quiet.

questions.q: I'm tired. "I wish I ___ go to bed now."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I could go to bed now.

questions.q: It's cold. "If only it ___ warmer."
questions.read_aloud: If only it were warmer.

questions.q: I never see my cousins. "I wish I ___ them more."
questions.read_aloud: I wish I saw them more.

questions.q: He didn't call me. "I wish he ___ me."
questions.read_aloud: I wish he had called me.

questions.q: We have a test tomorrow. "If only we ___ a test tomorrow."
questions.read_aloud: If only we didn't have a test tomorrow.

questions.q: She can't come. "I wish she ___ come."
questions.read_aloud: I wish she could come.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
choices: I wish I have more time.
I wish I will have more time.
I wish I having more time.
I wish I had more time.
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had more time.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
choices: If only I knew the answer.
If only I know the answer.
If only I will know the answer.
If only I knowing the answer.
questions.read_aloud: If only I knew the answer.

questions.q: Which sentence is about a regret in the past?
questions.read_aloud: I wish I had listened.
